commands.label: alpine-apkovl-build-corrected
commands.note: CORRECTED: Build apkovl overlay (auto-login root via agetty, .profile launches claude CLI). Write ventoy.json with correct control array. All hidden.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$vdrive = $null; foreach ($d in @('D:','E:')) { if (Test-Path $d) { $vdrive = $d; break } }; if (-not $vdrive) { Write-Output 'NO_DRIVE'; exit 1 }; $ovl = "$env:TEMP\alpine_ovl2"; if (Test-Path $ovl) { Remove-Item $ovl -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory -Path "$ovl\etc" | Out-Null; New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory -Path "$ovl\root" | Out-Null; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$ovl\etc\inittab", "::sysinit:/sbin/openrc sysinit`n::sysinit:/sbin/openrc boot`n::wait:/sbin/openrc default`ntty1::respawn:/sbin/agetty --autologin root tty1 linux`ntty2::respawn:/sbin/agetty 38400 tty2 linux`n::shutdown:/sbin/openrc shutdown`n"); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$ovl\root\.profile", "clear`necho 'Alpine Claude CLI Boot'`necho '====================='`nif command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1; then`n  claude`nelse`n  echo 'First boot: installing nodejs npm git curl...'`n  apk add --no-cache nodejs npm git curl`n  npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`n  claude`nfi`n"); $tarOut = "$vdrive\localhost.apkovl.tar.gz"; Set-Location $ovl; tar -czf $tarOut .; Write-Output "APKOVL_OK:$tarOut"; New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory -Path "$vdrive\ventoy" | Out-Null; $vj = '{"control":[{"VTOY_DEFAULT_MENU_MODE":"0"},{"VTOY_MENU_TIMEOUT":"5"}]}'; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$vdrive\ventoy\ventoy.json", $vj); Write-Output 'VENTOY_JSON_OK'; New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory -Path "$vdrive\claude_boot" | Out-Null; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$vdrive\claude_boot\README.txt", "Alpine Claude CLI Autoboot (research-validated 2026-10-28)`n========================================================`nISO: alpine-standard-3.24.3-x86_64.iso (already on drive)`nOverlay: localhost.apkovl.tar.gz (auto-login root + claude CLI)`nventoy.json: VTOY_DEFAULT_MENU_MODE=0, VTOY_MENU_TIMEOUT=5`n`nBoot: F12 -> Ventoy USB -> Alpine entry (auto-selects in 5s)`nFirst boot: installs nodejs/npm/git/curl + claude (~2 min, needs wifi)`nNext boots: runs claude directly`n`nLBU persistence tip:`n  After setup-alpine (set disk=none, lbu storage=USB):`n  umount /media/usb && lbu commit`n  This saves /etc + packages to overlay on USB for next boot.`n"); Write-Output 'README_OK'; Set-Location $env:TEMP; Remove-Item $ovl -Recurse -Force"
